lines.zh: 我这条老蜥蜴只晒太阳。

lines.en: Chews on a blade of grass slowly

lines.zh: 四个爪印拖出一条尾痕。
lines.en: Four claw prints drag a tail line behind.

lines.zh: 四肢交替，肚皮擦过落叶。
lines.en: Limbs ticking over, belly brushing the leaves.
I crawl slowly around my nest.

lines.zh: 爬到阳光最足的石头上去。
lines.en: I climb onto the sunniest stone.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖扫开挡路的枯枝。
lines.en: My tail tip sweeps a dry twig aside.
Step by step I move toward the low grass.

lines.zh: 爪子在泥地上留下细印。
lines.en: My claws leave fine marks in the mud.

lines.zh: 石头上暖，尾巴搭在下面。
lines.en: The rock is warm; my tail rests below it.

lines.zh: 舌头转一圈，鳞片就亮了。
lines.en: One pass of my tongue and the scales shine.

lines.zh: 这只大蜥蜴，晒够太阳才肯动。
lines.en: This big lizard won't move till it's sunned enough.
Flat on a stone, eyes half shut.
At the sound of insects, my ears twitch.
I coil my tail around me.
The sun moved, so I shifted too.
I guard the nest without moving.
I flick my tongue to taste the air.
My scales bristle; don't come closer.

lines.zh: 我半睁着眼，看你敢不敢动。
lines.en: I keep one eye half open, waiting to see if you dare move.
Can my teeth dent that tin shell of yours?
I raise my head and my throat puffs.
I put myself between you and the nest.
My young are still in the nest.
Pain makes it hard to breathe...

lines.zh: 蜥蜴妈妈的腿，也是肉做的。
lines.en: Even Momma Lizzy's legs are made of meat.

lines.zh: 我这身鳞片，挡不住这一下。
lines.en: These scales couldn't stop that one.
My scales are cracked; I need to hide.
My scales are all but gone.
I’ve taken a lot of damage...
Don't go, let's share the food!

lines.zh: 你手里的虫子我看见了。
lines.en: I see the bug in your hand.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的蛋在下面。
lines.en: Not too close; my eggs are down there.

lines.zh: 这块地方晒得正好，你也来？
lines.en: This spot is just right; care to join?

lines.zh: 我的鳞是绿的，你看见了吗？
lines.en: My scales are green. Do you see them?
Bring it over, I smell it.
Set it down slowly, no reaching.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一甩，别站身后。
lines.en: My tail swings; don't stand behind me.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片硬，撞上来会疼。
lines.en: My scales are hard — bumping me will hurt.
My tail sweeps a clump of grass aside.
My tail swings around; back off.
Move; my nest is over there.
Don't come near while I'm brooding.

lines.zh: 我这只蜥蜴妈妈只认刷怪蛋。
lines.en: This momma lizard answers only to a spawn egg.

lines.zh: 蜥蜴妈妈点个头，就当答应。
lines.en: One nod from Momma Lizzy is a yes.
My eggs need the warm stones.
Come watch the nest for a while.
You have scales too. Then stay.
Come back to the nest; the eggs are still warm.
Be careful, don't hurt my babies.
I need to find my eggs.
I dig my claws into the soil.

lines.zh: 蜥蜴妈妈盯着你的脚踝。

lines.en: My tail slaps the ground and I charge.
Be careful, this is my territory.

lines.zh: 保护我的孩子，别伤害它们。
lines.en: Protect my babies, don't hurt them.
Be careful, this is my family.

lines.zh: 我的孩子比你想象的更有用。
lines.en: My babies are more useful than you think.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，张开大口咬住你！
lines.en: Hisss, open wide and bite you!

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，朝你脸上拍去！
伸长舌头，吸吮你的血液！
lines.en: Long tongue out, sucking your blood!

lines.zh: 咬破皮肉，流出鲜红血液！
尖牙利齿，深深嵌入肉中！
lines.en: Sharp teeth, sink deep into flesh!

lines.zh: 尾巴缠绕，紧紧勒住脖子！
lines.en: Tail wraps around, choking your neck!

lines.zh: 用力一咬，断掉你的手臂！
lines.en: Grip tight, snap off your arm!

lines.zh: 利爪划破皮肤，流出鲜血！
张大嘴巴，露出利齿咬你！
用尾巴缠绕，阻止你逃跑！
从岩缝中慢慢探出头来！
穿过洞穴，出现在你的面前！
lines.en: Crawls out of caves, in front of you!

lines.zh: 从石头下慢慢爬出身体！
lines.en: Slowly crawls out from under the stone!

lines.zh: 从洞穴出口慢慢地现身！
从树根下缓缓探出头来！
在地面上慢慢移动现身！
lines.en: Slowly moves and appears on the ground!

lines.zh: 从洞穴深处慢慢爬出身体！
lines.en: Slowly crawls out from deep inside the cave!
The ledge was too high; my tail hit first.
My ears are full of ringing.

lines.zh: 蜥蜴妈妈的鳞全翘起来了。
lines.en: Momma Lizzy's scales are all standing up.
So hungry my scales stick to bone.
My scales still carry the charge. Numb.

lines.zh: 掉下去，连窝都看不见了。
lines.en: I fall until I cannot see my nest.
